question: Whom among the following players is associated with Javelin throw?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Neeraj Chopra.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Neeraj Chopra** is an **Indian athlete** who specializes in the** javelin throw** and is the current national record holder in the event.
 
• He won the **gold medal** at the **2018 Asian Games** and the **2018 Commonwealth Games**, and also represented India at the **2020 Tokyo Olympics.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Pankaj Advani** is a **billiards and snooker player** from India who has won multiple world championships in his sport.
 
• **Saurabh Chaudhary** is a **shooter from India** who won a **gold medal** at the** 2018 Asian Games** and the** 2018 Youth Olympics.**
 
• **Manika Batra** is a **table tennis playe**r from India who won multiple medals at the **2018 Commonwealth Games** and the **2018 Asian Games.**
 
• Therefore, the** correct answer** to the question is option 1, Neeraj Chopra, who is associated with javelin throw.
